title: Loss-Guided Tsetlin Machines: Making the Learning Objective Explicit
abstract: arXiv:2611.26114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Tsetlin Machine (TM) has no explicit notion of a loss function. Its learning signal is fixed to an implicit, margin-based update rule (MBUR), with no way to choose an objective function suited to a specific task. This paper introduces Loss-Guided TM, which replaces MBUR with an explicit and swappable loss function. In our proposed method, clause feedback and weight updates are driven by the loss, while keeping the Tsetlin Automaton and clause logic unchanged. The approach incorporates cross entropy (CE), symmetric cross entropy (SCE), and asymmetric loss (ASL). We evaluate Loss-Guided TM across six datasets that span multiclass, multilabel, and binary classification tasks. With a suitable loss, Loss-Guided TM matches or improves accuracy and F1 over MBUR on five of the six datasets. translated_title: 损失引导的Tsetlin机器：使学习目标显式化
translated_abstract: Tsetlin机器（TM）没有显式的损失函数概念，其学习信号被固定为一种隐式的、基于间隔的更新规则（MBUR），无法针对特定任务选择合适的目标函数。本文提出了损失引导的Tsetlin机器（Loss-Guided TM），用一个显式且可替换的损失函数取代MBUR。在所提出的方法中，子句反馈和权重更新由损失函数驱动，同时保持Tsetlin自动机和子句逻辑不变。该方法引入了交叉熵（CE）、对称交叉熵（SCE）和非对称损失（ASL）。我们在涵盖多分类、多标签和二分类任务的六个数据集上对Loss-Guided TM进行了评估。通过选择合适的损失函数，Loss-Guided TM在六个数据集中的五个上达到或超越了MBUR的准确率和F1分数。收益在不平衡的多标签数据集上最为显著，其中ASL将宏平均F1提升了高达9个百分点。使用CE时，Loss-Guided TM还……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Loss-Guided Tsetlin机器，用显式可替换的损失函数（CE、SCE、ASL）取代其固有的隐式间隔更新规则，在不改变Tsetlin自动机与子句逻辑的前提下，在六个分类数据集中的五个上匹配或提升了准确率与F1，尤其在不平衡多标签任务上将宏平均F1最多提升9个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Loss-Guided Tsetlin Machines, which replace the implicit margin-based update rule with an explicit, swappable loss function (CE, SCE, ASL), matching or improving accuracy and F1 on five of six datasets and boosting macro F1 by up to 9 percentage points on imbalanced multilabel tasks.
